title: Web search
description: Choose the search provider the assistant may call for live web results.
loadFailed: Could not load web search settings.
unauthorized: Please sign in again to continue.
forbidden: This action is not allowed for this account.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
serviceUnavailable: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
requestFailed: The request failed. Check the provider, endpoint and key.
saveFailed: Could not save web search settings.
keepSaved: Leave blank to keep the saved key
key.neverShown: Saved keys are never shown. Enter a new one to replace it.
allowRemote: Allow assistant web searches through these providers
noProviders: No providers yet. Add one to start.
envNote: Each provider address must be on the allowed list in the server settings. The daily search limit and allowed networks are also set there.
key.required: Tavily, Brave and OmniRoute need an API key; SearXNG needs none.
fallbackNote: Providers are tried in order; if one fails, the next provider is tried.
test.label: Test connection
test.errorCredentialRequired: Enter an API key to test this provider.
test.errorNetworkDenied: The endpoint is blocked by network policy or is not allow-listed.
test.errorTimeout: The provider did not respond in time.
